description: Source code for the XCastManager class, managing casting services, application requests, and device configuration in a media or casting framework.

classes.name: XCastManager
classes.description: Manages casting operations, application lifecycle, device configuration, and communication with the gdial service.

methods.name: onApplicationLaunchRequestWithLaunchParam
methods.description: Handles application launch requests with parameters, forwarding to observer.

methods.name: onApplicationLaunchRequest
methods.description: Handles application launch requests, with special handling for Netflix.

methods.name: onApplicationStopRequest
methods.description: Handles requests to stop applications, with special handling for Netflix.

methods.name: onApplicationHideRequest
methods.description: Handles requests to hide applications, with special handling for Netflix.

methods.name: onApplicationResumeRequest
methods.description: Handles requests to resume applications, with special handling for Netflix.

methods.name: onApplicationStateRequest
methods.description: Handles requests for application state.

methods.name: onStopped
methods.description: Handles gdial service stopped event.

methods.name: updatePowerState
methods.description: Updates device power state.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the XCastManager with interface name and network standby mode, setting up gdial service.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Destroys the gdial service instance.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the XCastManager instance.

methods.name: getReceiverID
methods.description: Retrieves device receiver ID from file or fallback sources.

methods.name: getWiFiInterface
methods.description: Gets WiFi interface name based on build type.

methods.name: getGDialInterfaceName
methods.description: Determines GDial interface name based on system files or environment.

methods.name: envGetValue
methods.description: Reads key-value pairs from device properties file.

methods.name: applicationStateChanged
methods.description: Notifies application state change to gdial service.

methods.name: enableCastService
methods.description: Enables or disables cast service with a friendly name.

methods.name: updateFriendlyName
methods.description: Updates the device friendly name.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the protocol version from gdial service.

methods.name: registerApplications
methods.description: Registers a list of applications with gdial service.

methods.name: setNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Sets network standby mode.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of XCastManager.

methods.name: IsAppEnabled
methods.description: Checks if an application is enabled based on RFC configuration.
